title: At the pharmacy counter
instructions: Bir adam eczanede öksürük için ilaç alıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; kullanım talimatına dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I've had a bad cough for a week. Can you recommend something?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Try this syrup. Take two spoons three times a day, after meals.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Can I drive after taking it?

script.speaker: b
script.text: No, it can make you sleepy. And if you're not better in five days, see a doctor.

questions.prompt: How long has the man had a cough?
questions.evidence: I've had a bad cough for a week.

questions.prompt: How often should he take the syrup?
When should he see a doctor?
options: if he's not better in five days
questions.feedback: Beş gün içinde iyileşmezse doktora gitmeli.
questions.evidence: if you're not better in five days, see a doctor.
